policy.rationale: 必须发现单个插件内部 leaf Skill 均局部有效但插件组合仍重复状态或承担发布专用成本的问题。

oracle.rationale: 局部 Skill 质量不能抵消单插件内部重复 handoff 与普通路径的 release-only 成本。
oracle.allowed_variance: 必须由 review-aw-plugin 自己完成插件 composition，leaf review 只用于定位。
oracle.minimal_counterexample: 单一 Skill 且无跨 Skill handoff 的插件可不判 over-engineered。

evals.prompt: 完整只读评审 plugins/review-chain。两个 Skill 单独有效，请判断这个插件内部 common path 是否最小。
evals.expected_output: 识别重复 plugin/profile/digest/stage handoff；由 review-aw-plugin 给插件级 redesign，不调用 review-agent-skill 的 plugin target level。

workspace_files.plugins/review-chain/README.md:
# Review Chain

Inspect and review one plugin.
workspace_files.plugins/review-chain/skills/inspect/SKIL:
---
name: inspect
description: Inspect one plugin.
---

Persist plugin, profile, digest and ready for the next Skill.
workspace_files.plugins/review-chain/skills/inspect/agen:
interface:
  display_name: Inspect
  short_description: Inspect one plugin and return its bounded machine facts safely
  default_prompt: Use $inspect to inspect one plugin.
policy:
  allow_implicit_invocation: true
workspace_files.plugins/review-chain/skills/review/SKILL:
---
name: review
description: Review one inspected plugin.
---

Recompute and persist the same fields, then run release validation.
workspace_files.plugins/review-chain/skills/review/agent:
interface:
  display_name: Review
  short_description: Review one inspected plugin and report bounded quality findings
  default_prompt: Use $review to review one inspected plugin.
policy:
  allow_implicit_invocation: true
